# DearSQL

> DearSQL is a fast, native desktop SQL client built with C++ and ImGui. It connects to SQLite, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, MSSQL, Cassandra, and Redshift from a single app. Available for macOS, Linux, and Windows. No Electron, no JVM — starts in under a second.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://dearsql.dev/)
- [Changelog](https://dearsql.dev/changelog)

- [Redis client features](https://dearsql.dev/redis)
- [Tech stack](https://dearsql.dev/stack)

## Docs

- [Docs overview](https://dearsql.dev/docs)
- [Connections](https://dearsql.dev/docs/connections): connect to SQLite, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis and more, over SSL or an SSH tunnel
- [Browsing data](https://dearsql.dev/docs/browsing-data): the sidebar tree, table viewer, filtering, inline editing and the inspector panel
- [SQL editor](https://dearsql.dev/docs/sql-editor): run queries, read multi-statement results, keep scripts around
- [Import and export](https://dearsql.dev/docs/import-export): SQL dumps for MySQL and PostgreSQL, plus CSV files
- [AI assistant](https://dearsql.dev/docs/ai-assistant): use Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor or an API key inside the app
- [AI context and commands](https://dearsql.dev/docs/ai-context): pin tables with @, run commands with /
- [AI database tools](https://dearsql.dev/docs/ai-database-tools): let the agent search your schema, run read-only queries and open connections

## Pricing

Free tier: all database types and core features, up to 3 saved connections and 2 workspaces. No credit card required.
Pro: $35 one-time purchase — unlimited connections and workspaces, all current and future features.

## Supported Databases

SQLite, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, MSSQL, Cassandra, Redshift.

## Key Features

- Syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and query history
- Browse and edit table data inline — changes generate proper SQL before committing
- Schema browser: tables, views, indexes, sequences, and more
- SSH tunneling for all server-type databases (password or private key auth)
- TLS/SSL support with configurable modes per database (disable, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full)
- Saved connections with AES-encrypted credentials
- AI assistant: run Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor or Google Antigravity inside the app (Agent Client Protocol), or use an Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key
- Agent database tools (MCP): the agent can list tables, run read-only queries and open saved connections
- SQL dump import/export for MySQL and PostgreSQL, CSV import/export, and querying CSV files with DuckDB
- Native rendering: Metal on macOS, OpenGL on Linux, DirectX on Windows
